name: What appliances should I choose first in a custom kitchen design?

mainEntity.name: What appliances should I choose first in a custom kitchen design?
mainEntity.text: What appliances should I choose first in a custom kitchen design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appliances should be chosen early in the custom kitchen design process because they influence cabinet sizing, counter depths, clearances, and utility locations. The refrigerator is often the first item to confirm, followed by the range or cooktop, hood, dishwasher, and any specialty units like wine storage or built-in coffee systems. Each appliance may have different rough-in requirements and installation tolerances, and those details need to be built into the drawings before cabinetry is fabricated. If appliances are selected too late, the kitchen may require expensive cabinet modifications or layout compromises. Homeowners should also verify whether the appliance package is counter-depth, panel-ready, or standard-size, since those choices affect the final aesthetic. For custom kitchens in Los Angeles, it is smart to coordinate appliance selection with the designer and contractor at the same time so ventilation, electrical, and plumbing are all aligned before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Appliances should be selected early because their exact dimensions, venting needs, and utility requirements affect cabinet design and layout. The refrigerator, range, hood, and dishwasher are especially important because they determine clearances and surrounding millwork.
